summary: Allow independent section UI, correct web regression coverage, map 296 requirements, prove isolated offline feasibility, add encrypted local follow-up drafts, and add optional actor-scoped durable scheduling request identities in crm-followups. Production offline synchronization remains disabled pending native PostgreSQL acceptance. Repair native bootstrap file-key incompatibility using a new data-preserving prerequisite migration.
protectedReason: The owner explicitly requested removing premature visual-layout restrictions across ALL sections while preserving accounting, security, module ownership, shared-shell change scope and migration integrity. Replace blanket presentation bans with scoped-stylesheet checks and executable isolation tests. Add nullable request identity columns and a unique index only on crm-followups-owned rows through a new additive migration; no accepted migration changes. The owner requested resolving the local PostgreSQL execution blocker without delaying work; run the existing native acceptance and full migration chain in a bounded disposable Docker database inside the existing PR quality job. No new hosted job or permanent infrastructure. Native fresh-database execution exposed an existing UUID/TEXT FK incompatibility. Add an explicit prerequisite migration aligning the owned Platform file key to its canonical TEXT contract; retain IDs/links, preserve all historical migration files, and test both bootstrap and populated upgrade cases.
